We’re looking into this now. In the meantime, since you mentioned a manual work-around is available, please continue using that for exports you need to complete by the deadline.

To help us reproduce and isolate the failure quickly, could you share the following (if available):
1) The timestamp(s) when you first saw the 500 error today (and your timezone)
2) Which invoice(s) you’re exporting when it fails (invoice ID(s) are fine)
3) The browser/app version or environment (e.g., production, staging if applicable)
4) Any error details from the browser/network logs (request/response details around the 500)

Once we have that, we’ll continue investigation and keep you updated on progress.
